requirement: Every platform's LOOK line tells the agent to read the element back with page.look after a hand-written look change, before telling the customer it is done

oracle.ref: PR #1100 (fix); fix evidence: Stand 09–10/10/2026, WordPress T3: the agent wrote a look by hand and claimed success without reading the computed value back.
oracle.invariant: For wordpress, joomla and emdash, a mode with a shell gets in its LOOK line: 'After a change by hand, read the element again with `page.look` and tell the customer the value it now shows — never that it is done without that reading.' A mode without a shell (Writer) does not get that sentence. The three tests are ok and the run exits 0.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
